ceu: ✦ The trine between Venus and Saturn

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between Venus and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.
